prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a polished ultrawide GitHub profile banner, 3:1 composition, suitable for a dark fantasy profile.
Primary request: an original crossover illustration combining the delicate hand-drawn atmosphere of Hollow Knight, the monumental decaying gothic world and quiet embers of Dark Souls, and Neferpitou from Hunter x Hunter as the central character.
Scene: a vast ruined cathedral opening onto a misty subterranean kingdom, slender vaulted arches fading into blue fog, tangled dark foreground foliage, small floating pale motes, a tiny bonfire with a sword embedded in ash adding a restrained warm amber accent.
Subject: recognizable Neferpitou, tousled short white hair, feline ears, red eyes, dark blue high-collared double-breasted jacket with golden buttons, modest fully clothed costume, long feline tail, calmly sitting on a ruined stone ledge near the bonfire. Their face should remain recognizably anime and readable at banner size.
Style: elegant dark fantasy illustration, painterly environment with delicate ink outlines, atmospheric depth and clean character design, a coherent single scene, not a collage.
Composition: ultrawide panorama, character near the center, architecture stretching to both sides, preserve the full head and ears with comfortable margins, readable silhouette at small sizes. Art fills the whole canvas edge to edge.
Palette: near-black navy, charcoal, desaturated steel blue, luminous silver-white, restrained amber embers.
Mood: mysterious, melancholic, quietly adventurous.
Constraints: no text, no lettering, no title, no logo, no watermark, no UI, no gore, no sexualization. This is a new illustration, not a copied game screenshot.
storage: Git LFS; image generation requires the external image generation tool.
edit_prompt: Edit this existing ultrawide dark fantasy banner. Change only Neferpitou's treatment into a dark, elegant silhouette. Preserve the exact pose, scale, position, feline ears, tousled hair outline and curled tail. Face, eyes, hands, hair interior and clothing should be mostly solid near-black charcoal/navy with no readable facial features, no visible eyes and no bright white face or white hair mass. Add only a very fine desaturated silver-blue rim light along portions of the ears, hair and tail, and a faint amber edge nearest the bonfire, so the silhouette stays readable against the cathedral. Keep the entire environment, ruined cathedral, mist, bonfire, sword, small luminous motes, original ultrawide 3:1 composition and palette unchanged. Do not add text, logos, extra figures or other elements.
final_edit_prompt:
Edit the provided ultrawide dark fantasy banner with exactly three targeted changes.
1. Neferpitou remains a near-black silhouette in the same pose, scale and position. Restore only the visible eyes as subtle deep crimson/red irises, recognizably the original red eye color. Keep the rest of the face in shadow, no white skin or bright hair mass, no lasers or exaggerated glow.
2. Add the Knight from Hollow Knight VERY far in the background, standing on a distant stone bridge in the right half of the scene. It is a tiny atmospheric easter egg, about 3–4% of the image height, with its recognizable pale mask, two curved horns, black eye holes and tiny dark cloak. It must be much smaller than Neferpitou and integrated into the depth and mist, never foreground.
3. Feather all four outer borders smoothly to genuine transparent alpha, especially bottom and side edges, so the painting naturally fades into any webpage background. Keep the central 80% of the scene solid and richly detailed. Avoid a hard rectangular edge, white fringe, black matte, decorative border or painted checkerboard.
Preserve the existing composition, ruined gothic cathedral and distant kingdom, blue mist, bonfire and sword, lighting, foliage and tiny luminous motes. Preserve the ultrawide 3:1 aspect ratio. No text, logos, other figures or additional changes.
